# Windows Central

> Windows Central is the definitive source for news, reviews, and how-to guides covering Microsoft's Windows operating systems, AI assistants, and enterprise productivity tools.

Windows Central provides comprehensive coverage of Windows 10 and Windows 11, Microsoft Copilot and AI features, Surface hardware, Microsoft 365, Teams, and the broader Microsoft ecosystem. The site combines breaking news, in-depth tutorials, product comparisons, and troubleshooting guides for both consumers and IT professionals.

## Key Topics

- Windows 11
- Windows 10
- Microsoft Copilot
- Artificial Intelligence
- Microsoft 365
- Surface Hardware
- Windows Security
- How-to Guides
- Troubleshooting
- Microsoft Teams
- Microsoft Office
- Bing Search
- AI Features
- System Updates
- End-of-Support

## Windows Operating Systems

- [Windows 11 News and Updates](https://www.windowscentral.com/microsoft/windows/windows-11): Windows 11 news, updates, and feature announcements
- [Windows 11 News](https://www.windowscentral.com/microsoft/windows/windows-11/news): Windows 11 latest news, updates, and AI feature coverage
- [Windows 11 How-Tos](https://www.windowscentral.com/microsoft/windows/windows-11/how-to): Windows 11 tutorials, optimization, and troubleshooting guides
- [Windows 10 News and Updates](https://www.windowscentral.com/microsoft/windows/windows-10): Windows 10 news, updates, and end-of-support information
- [Windows 10 News](https://www.windowscentral.com/microsoft/windows/windows-10/news): Windows 10 latest news, security updates, and migration guides
- [Windows 10 How-Tos](https://www.windowscentral.com/microsoft/windows/windows-10/how-to): Windows 10 tutorials and how-to guides for system tasks
- [Windows Help Coverage](https://www.windowscentral.com/microsoft/windows/windows-help): Windows 10/11 help guides, tutorials, and troubleshooting

## Microsoft AI & Copilot

- [Artificial Intelligence Coverage](https://www.windowscentral.com/artificial-intelligence): Latest AI news and features including Microsoft Copilot
- [Microsoft Copilot](https://www.windowscentral.com/artificial-intelligence/microsoft-copilot): Microsoft Copilot AI assistant news, reviews, and how-to guides
- [Microsoft Copilot Plus vs. Copilot: What's the difference?](https://www.windowscentral.com/microsoft/microsoft-copilot-plus-vs-copilot): Comparison guide between Copilot Plus and standard Copilot
- [Bing News and Updates](https://www.windowscentral.com/microsoft/bing): Bing search engine news, updates, and AI features

## Microsoft Products & Services
